Retry Policy

Webhook deliveries are retried five times, and the delivery log records each attempt.

Backoff

Backoff doubles after every failed attempt.

  • first retry after 1 s
  • second retry after 2 s
attempt delay
1 1 s
2 2 s 
delay = 2 ** attempt

Deliveries stop after the fifth failure.
